import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression

def task_func(df):
    if not isinstance(df, pd.DataFrame):
        df = pd.DataFrame(df)

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()

    if df.empty:
        ax.set_title("Stock Closing Price Prediction")
        ax.set_xlabel("Date")
        ax.set_ylabel("Closing Price")
        return [], ax

    def _select_date_column(frame):
        candidates = ("date", "datetime", "timestamp", "time")
        for col in frame.columns:
            col_name = str(col).lower()
            if any(candidate in col_name for candidate in candidates):
                return col
        return None

    def _select_close_column(frame, date_col=None):
        candidates = ("close", "closing", "adj close", "adj_close", "price")
        for col in frame.columns:
            if col == date_col:
                continue
            col_name = str(col).lower()
            if any(candidate in col_name for candidate in candidates):
                return col

        numeric_cols = [
            col for col in frame.columns
            if col != date_col and pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(frame[col])
        ]
        if numeric_cols:
            return numeric_cols[-1]

        other_cols = [col for col in frame.columns if col != date_col]
        return other_cols[-1] if other_cols else None

    date_col = _select_date_column(df)
    close_col = _select_close_column(df, date_col)

    if close_col is None:
        ax.set_title("Stock Closing Price Prediction")
        ax.set_xlabel("Date")
        ax.set_ylabel("Closing Price")
        return [], ax

    if date_col is not None:
        work = pd.DataFrame(
            {
                "_date": pd.to_datetime(df[date_col], errors="coerce"),
                "_close": pd.to_numeric(df[close_col], errors="coerce"),
            }
        )
    else:
        work = pd.DataFrame(
            {
                "_date": pd.to_datetime(df.index, errors="coerce"),
                "_close": pd.to_numeric(df[close_col], errors="coerce"),
            }
        )

    work = work.dropna(subset=["_date", "_close"]).sort_values("_date")

    if work.empty:
        ax.set_title("Stock Closing Price Prediction")
        ax.set_xlabel("Date")
        ax.set_ylabel("Closing Price")
        return [], ax

    historical_dates = work["_date"].to_numpy()
    historical_prices = work["_close"].to_numpy(dtype=float)

    step_seconds = 24 * 60 * 60
    last_timestamp = int(pd.Timestamp(work["_date"].iloc[-1]).timestamp())
    future_timestamps = last_timestamp + step_seconds * np.arange(1, 8, dtype=np.int64)
    future_dates = pd.to_datetime(future_timestamps, unit="s")

    if len(work) >= 2:
        train_timestamps = (work["_date"].astype("int64") // 10**9).to_numpy(dtype=np.int64)
        X = train_timestamps.reshape(-1, 1)
        y = historical_prices

        model = LinearRegression()
        model.fit(X, y)

        future_X = future_timestamps.reshape(-1, 1)
        predictions = model.predict(future_X).astype(float)

        all_timestamps = np.concatenate([train_timestamps, future_timestamps])
        all_dates = pd.to_datetime(all_timestamps, unit="s")
        regression_line = model.predict(all_timestamps.reshape(-1, 1)).astype(float)

        ax.plot(historical_dates, historical_prices, marker="o", label="Historical Close")
        ax.plot(all_dates, regression_line, linestyle="--", alpha=0.7, label="Linear Trend")
        ax.plot(future_dates, predictions, marker="o", linestyle="--", label="Predicted Next 7 Days")
    else:
        last_price = float(historical_prices[-1])
        predictions = np.full(7, last_price, dtype=float)

        ax.plot(historical_dates, historical_prices, marker="o", label="Historical Close")
        ax.plot(future_dates, predictions, marker="o", linestyle="--", label="Predicted Next 7 Days")

    ax.set_title("Stock Closing Price Prediction")
    ax.set_xlabel("Date")
    ax.set_ylabel("Closing Price")
    ax.legend()
    fig.autofmt_xdate()

    return predictions.tolist(), ax
